created_reason: Re-approved for baseline schema v4, which records each entry's approved result dimensions beside its classification and widens capability_required to cover approved safe invocations and observed transport features. A v3 document would have loaded cleanly and stated two things nobody approved: that every entry was measured as not security-relevant, and that a session-lifecycle or safe-invocation entry needed no observation of the target. Also re-measured because security.http_invalid_origin now classifies a failed Origin MUST as SPEC_VIOLATION and carries the security reading on its own dimension, rather than replacing the conformance outcome with a security label.
